Item.Name: LocalizableStrings.Label_RedirectUrlListDescription_caption.Value
Item.Value: Specify Redirect URIs that your external application will use to receive authorization codes during the OAuth 2.0 authorization. Each URI must match the redirect_uri parameter used in the OAuth request from your application and include the protocol, for example, https://yourapp.com/callback. Creatio accepts only the URIs listed here, otherwise the request will be rejected.
